learnMore.guide0Desc: Set up your admin workspace, configure platform defaults, and invite your first users in under 10 minutes.
learnMore.guide1Desc: Add, edit, suspend or remove learners and educators. Assign roles, reset passwords, and review activity logs.

learnMore.feat0Desc: Three distinct roles — Admin, Educator, Learner — each with scoped permissions and a tailored interface.
learnMore.feat1Desc: Real-time dashboards for enrollments, revenue, user distribution, and quiz performance.
learnMore.feat2Desc: Full i18n support. Switch language per-user or set a platform-wide default from Settings.
learnMore.feat3Desc: Customisable templates, automatic issuance on course completion, and shareable verification links.
learnMore.faq0Q: How do I reset a user's password?
learnMore.faq0A: Go to User Management → find the user → open the Actions menu → select "Reset Password". A new password is generated and you can share it securely with the user.
learnMore.faq1A: Bulk CSV import is on the roadmap for Q3. Today you can add users individually via User Management → Add User, or via the public registration flow.
learnMore.faq2A: Each certificate has a unique ID embedded in a shareable URL. Anyone with the link can verify authenticity on the public verification page without logging in.
learnMore.faq3Q: What happens when I suspend a user?
learnMore.faq3A: The user's session is invalidated immediately. They cannot log in until you reactivate them. Their data and enrollment records are preserved.
learnMore.faq4Q: How do I publish an educator's course?
learnMore.faq4A: Open Course Management → find the pending course → click the row action menu → select "Edit" → change status to Public. The course becomes visible to learners instantly.
learnMore.faq5Q: Where can I change the platform name shown to learners?
learnMore.faq5A: Settings → General → Platform Name. Changes take effect immediately across the UI.
